miniProject.title: Online policy optimization with versioned rollouts
miniProject.brief: Build critic-based and critic-free policy updates on frozen rollouts in `policylab`, prove freshness handling, then run a tiny online study with matched controls. The versioned collector and traces feed reasoning agents and the capstone evidence pack.
steps: Build the rollout collector in `llm/` with an exact sequence-gradient oracle and a written generation-policy contract, implement terminal-reward REINFORCE with detached rewards, and prove padding invariance with hand-gradient tests in `tests/`.

Implement the value-based fixed-rollout estimator with a critic-target oracle in `llm/`, compare critic state and fitting cost against group sampling in `ledger/`, and check RLOO baselines with prompt-regrouping tests and exact expected-gradient enumeration.

Normalize fixed prompt groups with both standard-deviation conventions in `llm/`, handle degenerate and singleton groups explicitly, and ablate reward transforms with matched gradient reductions, passing the free TensorTonic group-advantage cases.

Implement detached token ratios with sign-dependent clipping in `llm/`, check first-step equivalence with REINFORCE by autodiff, compare sequence, token and constant-denominator reductions on unequal lengths, and enumerate reference KL with EOS, padding and truncation tests, passing the free TensorTonic surrogate and length-normalization cases.

Replay zero-signal and verifier-failure batches with prompt-slice diagnostics, separate mastery from breakage and contraction, and enforce a bounded refill cap with all attempts and costs retained in `ledger/`.

Run a CPU online update with matched SFT, preference, rejection and best-of-N controls under a stated budget, and defend held-out quality with reward, KL, entropy, length and validity traces plus a reward-hacking pack across seeds, moving to a decoder only if your GPU fits it.
deliverables: The `llm/` rollout and estimator package with oracles and regression tests.
Normalization, clipping and freshness studies with drift and slice evidence.
Bounded online study with matched controls, traces and hacking pack.

rubric.pass: Frozen-rollout losses and gradients match hand oracles with ratio, mask and version defects caught.
rubric.strong: A constant-ratio defect passes loss equality yet fails the gradient check.

rubric.pass: Behavior scores stay immutable and stale-score injection fails with drift metrics recorded.
rubric.strong: A queue-age simulation names the reuse limit where correction breaks down.

rubric.pass: Zero-signal and verifier-failure replays carry distinct flags with bounded refill accounting.
rubric.strong: A verifier outage is shown to survive sampling fixes and routes to a data repair.

rubric.pass: Budgets reconcile across tokens, calls and updates with negative evidence retained across seeds.
rubric.strong: The verdict separates learned change from selection, length and evaluator effects.
